channel.description: Latest articles from Music Business Worldwide (MBW) (musicbusinessworldwide.com)

item.title: Google just launched Lyria 3 – its ‘most advanced’ AI music generator yet – in the Gemini app
item.description: Lyria 3 lets Gemini users create 30-second tracks from text prompts or images Source

item.title: Spotify says it has ‘helped artists generate’ $1bn+ in ticket sales to date. Now it’s teaming up with SeatGeek to drive even more
item.description: SeatGeek becomes the latest ticketing platform to join Spotify's growing live events ecosystem. Source

item.title: AWAL strikes global distribution deal with Italy’s Artist First
item.description: Artist First will offer local marketing and promotional services to AWAL artists looking to break into the Italian market. Source

item.title: Live Nation loses bid to dismiss DoJ antitrust lawsuit, trial set for March
item.description: US District Judge Arun Subramanian granted Live Nation's motion for summary judgment on some claims while allowing others to proceed. Source

item.title: Sony Music France acquires Paris-based indie label and publishing company Spookland
item.description: Spookland will transition into Bleu Revolver, which will continue operating as an independent label in partnership with Sony Music Group France. Source

item.title: Sphere Entertainment’s revenues topped $1.2bn in 2025, up 8% YoY; Wizard Of Oz has generated $290M since August launch
item.description: The Las Vegas venue's concert residencies in 2025 included the Eagles, Dead & Company, and the Backstreet Boys. Source

item.title: Meet Jake Basden, CEO of HYBE AMERICA Nashville’s Blue Highway Records: ‘I bring a manager’s mentality to the position.’
item.description: MBW caught up with Basden for an exclusive interview... Source

item.title: Chris Welz named partner at Secretly Distribution after company’s ‘biggest year ever’
item.description: The longtime COO steps into ownership after two decades at the independent distributor. Source

item.title: Live Nation annual revenues top $25B in 2025, up $2B YoY, with adjusted operating profit of $2.4B
item.description: Another banner year for Michael Rapino's company – complete with a US vs. non-US milestone Source

item.title: Live Nation says Ticketmaster breakup threat is already over, calls for DOJ settlement: ‘It’s time to move on.’
item.description: Live Nation's EVP of Corporate and Regulatory Affairs, Dan Wall, said the company is "ready" to reach a deal with the DOJ and state attorneys general Source
